summary: Gate of supervision, i48: 3 questions on r179. The writer's question 3 concerned r145, which is not a line this gate may ask about, so it is left out.
questions: r179, "terms of the proposal": a capability-proposal lists requirement ids, and terms are listed by a glossary-proposal. Line: [r179] **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the lines of a capability-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the requirement ids and terms of the proposal that the round's change list does not name. Reading A: split it into r179 (requirement ids of the capability-proposal) and r180 "**When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the terms of a glossary-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the terms of the glossary-proposal that the round's change list does not name." Reading B: drop "terms", so r179 reads "...shall keep the requirement ids of the capability-proposal that the round's change list does not name." Reading C: keep the line as drafted. Recommended: A.

r179, what "keep" means for the ids. Line: [r179] **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the lines of a capability-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the requirement ids and terms of the proposal that the round's change list does not name. Reading A: the ids stay in the `adds`, `changes` and `removes` that `work run` writes for the proposal (r159, r145), with the line as drafted. Reading B: the apply round is also given the earlier round's drafts of the lines not named, so the line reads "...`work run` shall give the round of the kind `apply` the kept drafts of the earlier round for each line the redraft's change list does not name." Recommended: A.

r179, which redraft the line covers. Line: [r179] **When** a round of the kind `integrate` redrafts some of the lines of a capability-proposal it was started for, `work run` shall keep the requirement ids and terms of the proposal that the round's change list does not name. Reading A: any round of the kind `integrate` started for a capability-proposal (r141, r150, r149) that redrafts a subset of its lines, as drafted. Reading B: only a redraft from answers (r142, r148). Recommended: A.
